verdict.rationale: Apple's own AI stack documents Apple Silicon support. MLX is described as an open-source framework for training and fine-tuning generative models on Apple Silicon, using Metal 4 and GPU Neural Accelerators. Core ML, MPS Graph and PyTorch Metal backends cover model integration and training, and the M4 Neural Engine runs on-device models. The evidence is generic to Apple Silicon rather than M4 Pro-specific, and no independent hands-on corroboration appears. missing for 10: evidence of llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime support, M4 Pro-specific runtime documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of local-AI runtime use.
